verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Sales Cloud covers deal pipeline tracking: "complete visibility into your pipeline", opportunity management, and Advanced Forecast & Pipeline Management. A community user also praises its customization, which loosely implies configurable stages. None of the evidence shows a visual board view, stage customization specifically, or drag-and-drop updates, so only the core deal-tracking part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: a documented visual/kanban pipeline view, explicit customizable opportunity stages, drag-and-drop stage updates, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the pipeline UX.
